evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026: profitability 2-3% above Kepler with the margin guide merely confirmed, and the stock fell 15.5% on 28 Jul. FY2025: guide well below consensus and a sharp fall on 2 Mar 2026 (Intesa). Q1 2026 confirmation: up about 8% on 27 Apr (baseline history, estimated date). This name has sold a beat with an unchanged guide.
evidence.why_not_priced: The stock fell 15.5% on a beat and trades at 1.916, only 6% above the post-H1 1.80 and down 6.3% in 20 days. If the market read the guide as conservative, the July sell-off would have reversed and the brokers would not sit at hold. Three analysts, $0.74m a day, and no disclosed short: nobody is positioned for a firming.

evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue has rarely been the line here. Q2 Europe outperformance of 6.7 points did not stop the -15.5% in July.
evidence.why_not_priced: A peer's regional revenue is a proxy nobody maps onto a 3-analyst Italian small cap. SGF fell over the same 20 days in which OPmobility's Q3 showed Europe strong, which is not what a priced read-across would look like. The finding is still a proxy and is sized small.

evidence.text: OPmobility cut its 2026 targets on 7 Oct and announced 770 European job cuts, citing 'a deterioration in the automotive market more pronounced than anticipated', lower global production forecasts and customer activity adjustments in Europe (shares -19%). This is a negative sector read for Sogefi's H2 guide.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sogefi's own caveat ('non si può escludere una temporanea flessione dei margini operativi') already sits in its July outlook. The stock fell 15.5% when it first appeared.
evidence.why_not_priced: Partly priced: SGF is -6.3% over 20 days and -3.5% over 5, overlapping the warning. Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until Sogefi says it, so the finding is sized small. A fully priced read would put SGF back near its July low of 1.80.
evidence.independence: Reuters via syndication, 21 Oct (https://whtc.com/?p=986707): targets lowered on lower global auto production forecasts and customer adjustments in Europe.

evidence.text: The United Springs (precision springs) sale closed on 31 Jul for EUR 23.5m of cash against H1 net debt of EUR 51.2m (EUR 8.3m pre-IFRS16). Q3 should therefore show pre-IFRS16 net cash for the first time, subject to a working-capital price adjustment.

evidence.why_not_priced: Public arithmetic, so mostly priced. The 'net cash' headline and any word on reinvestment or shareholder return is new, but small. The money funds 'investimenti ... di razionalizzazione' and core-market expansion, not distress.
